row.notes: SessionStateRedFlagRaceStrategy onEnter. Sets st+0xdb0, then decides whether to SKIP the strategy screen: st+0xdb1 = 1 and return 1 when (a) any entry of the human players list ([st+0xcb8]+0x100 +0x58..+0x60) has +100 set, +0x5b bit 0x10, +0x66 == 0 and (+0x65 == 0 or +0x91 == 2) - a player not yet back in the pits/ready - or (b) for any local player (g 0x146044988 +0x20 -> +0x140 +0x198/+0x1a0) the per-car race record ([st+0xcb0]+0x148)[Sess_Get_PlayerVehicleIndex] byte +0x18 != 2 (car not in the garage state). Otherwise st+0xdb1 = 0, builds the screen context (0x142a13860 with session [[st+0xca0]+0x88]+0x260 and st+0xdc0) and starts the fullscreen intro video on the UI feature system ([[st+0xc88]+0x28]+0x10 vcall +0xf0 -> +0x108: 0x14416df60, on_end = 0x142dfccc0, 0x14421c500 / 0x14421c620(4) / 0x14421c750); the screen content appears after the video's on_end. Practical rule for addons: the player's car record must be in state 2 when this state is entered, or the game skips the strategy screen in the same frame. (used by vmknolle red-flag-pit)
